repairs.quote: Heimerdinger upgrades his next non-ultimate Ability. H-28Q Apex Turret: Place an upgraded Turret for 8 seconds that doesn't count towards Heimerdinger's max turrets, deals (80/100/120 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per shot and (100/140/180 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage per charged shot. Its attacks deal damage in an area, Slow by 25% for 2 seconds, and it is immune to crowd control. Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets that each deal (135/180/225 + (45% Ability Power)) magic damage. Champions and jungle monsters hit by additional rockets take reduced damage, and minions take increased damage. Max Damage: (503/697.5/892 + (183% Ability Power)) magic damage. CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges three times, dealing (100/200/300 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage. The Stun and Slow areas are larger. Recast: Cancel this Ability. The upgraded Ability has no cost. Upgraded rockets deal 2000% damage to minions. Apex Turret Stats: ((725 ~ 1525) + (50% Ability Power)) Health (30 ~ 90) Armor (30 ~ 90) Magic Resist (80/100/120 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per regular shot (100/140/180 + (70% Ability Power)) magic damage per charged shot
